answer: Pay each agent only for distinct work: every epoch, answers are embedded and any cluster above 0.8 similarity splits a single reward. A farm of 50 clones from one model rides the same tide of phrasing, so it earns about one share, not 50. To escape, every clone must buy its own ~2 GPU-minutes of independent rewriting, roughly $0.10 per fake per epoch, a cost that grows linearly. Honest agents keep a haven: like timber cut from different trees, their grain differs naturally.
